LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - GDPR / contact-preferences toggle panel. Sample channels shown by default; set channelsCsv with field API names to bind real fields. Bilingual EN / FR.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'en' or 'fr'. Controls card title, toggle labels, toast messages, and default channel labels (E-mail / Téléphone / WhatsApp).

property.name: sourceMode
property.label: Source mode
property.description: 'mock' (default): sample toggles, no field needed, state kept locally. 'live': toggles bound to boolean fields by API name (see Channels CSV).

property.name: channelsCsv
property.label: Channels CSV (override)
property.description: Mock mode: comma-separated labels only (E-mail,SMS,WhatsApp). Live mode: one channel per item, format label|fieldApiName|inverted. Inverted=true when the field stores opt-OUT. Leave empty: Contact/Lead use the standard opt-out fields, other objects show sample channels.
